subject: Game Theory
title: Hostage Negotiation
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Hostage Negotiation.

hook.text: FBI hostage negotiators have a rule: slow everything down. Time is on the negotiator's side.

buildup.text: Hostage-takers are emotional and impulsive. Creating rapport reduces their adrenaline and irrational decisions.

discovery.text: Active listening—repeating their words, validating feelings—builds trust without making concessions.

twist.text: The FBI almost never gives in to demands. Instead, they stall, build trust, and wait for the taker's resolve to fade.

climax.text: Chris Voss, a former FBI negotiator, applied these techniques to business and wrote a bestseller.

quiz.question: What is the FBI's key hostage negotiation strategy?
